name: Air Jordan 5 Retro T23 'Tokyo' 2025
story_html: The 2025 edition of the Air Jordan 5 Retro T23 'Tokyo' revives a 2011 limited release that dropped exclusively in Japan. Like the original, this reissue sports a bright yellow nubuck upper with translucent quarter panel netting and grey molded eyelets. A Jumpman logo adorns the silver reflective tongue in black embroidery, matching the textile collar lining, stylized '23' on the lateral heel, and the second Jumpman icon that adorns the back heel.
